# `voxel/ChunkRegistry.js`

> **Source:** `engine/voxel/ChunkRegistry.js`

ChunkRegistry.js - Central Chunk Existence and Integrity Registry Solves: 1. Duplicate generation - fast O(1) existence check before generating 2. Corruption detection - content hash verification 3. Race conditions - atomic claim/release for chunk operations 4. Missing chunks - tracks all known chunks with metadata Uses: - In-memory Map for fast lookups - Content hashing (xxHash) for integrity verification - Temp file staging for atomic saves - Persistent index file for cross-session awareness

## Classes

### `class BloomFilter`

Bloom Filter for ultra-fast chunk existence checks - O(1) time for add/check - No false negatives (if says "no", definitely doesn't exist) - Small false positive rate (~0.8%) - Uses ~2% memory of equivalent Set

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(size = BLOOM_SIZE)` |  |
| `_getIndices` | `_getIndices(cx, cy, cz)` | Generate k hash indices from chunk coordinates Uses double hashing: h(i) = h1 + i*h2 |
| `add` | `add(cx, cy, cz)` | Add chunk to bloom filter |
| `mightExist` | `mightExist(cx, cy, cz)` | Check if chunk might exist (no false negatives) |
| `clear` | `clear()` | Clear the bloom filter |
| `getFalsePositiveRate` | `getFalsePositiveRate()` | Get estimated false positive rate |

### `encodeMorton3D(x, y, z)`

Encode 3D chunk coordinates to Morton code (Z-order) Interleaves bits for better cache locality in spatial queries

**Parameters:**

- `x` *(number)* — Chunk X (-1024 to 1023)
- `y` *(number)* — Chunk Y (-1024 to 1023)
- `z` *(number)* — Chunk Z (-1024 to 1023)

**Returns:** 32-bit Morton code

## Notes & Examples

### Voxel World System

The voxel system provides chunked 3D grids with fast access, mesh generation, and level-of-detail (LOD). Chunks are 32³ by default and stream in/out based on camera position. The mesher generates greedy or marching-cubes geometry depending on material.

**Example: Creating and modifying a voxel world**
```js
import { VoxelWorld } from 'engine/voxel/VoxelWorld.js';
import { VoxelMesher } from 'engine/voxel/VoxelMesher.js';

const world = new VoxelWorld({
  chunkSize: 32,
  loadDistance: 8  // chunks
});

// Set voxel at world position
world.setVoxel(10, 5, 10, {
  type: 'grass',
  color: [0.2, 0.7, 0.1]
});

world.setVoxel(10, 4, 10, { type: 'dirt' });

// Generate mesh for rendering
const mesher = new VoxelMesher(world);
const geometry = mesher.generateChunk(0, 0, 0);

// Raycast to find clicked voxel
const hit = world.raycast(rayOrigin, rayDir, 100);
if (hit) {
  world.setVoxel(hit.x, hit.y, hit.z, null);  // Remove
}
```
